title: Passive Voice: News Headlines and Tact — Quiz 119
content:
## Passive Voice: News Headlines and Tact

Explore passive constructions used for tact and in newspaper headlines.

### Lesson focus

1. I have been ordered not to let anybody in.
2. I have been ordered to direct the late comers to the boss.
3. City trader (was) robbed of Rs. 5 lakhs.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
